An {{effect}} that returns a <c:ffff00>{{knocked_out}}<c> <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c> to the
<c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c>.

It is mostly an <c:ffff00>action<c> of <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> with the <c:ffff00>Heal skill<c>.

All the {{part|pl}} of a revived {{medabot}} are <c:ffff00>restored<c>, and
<c:ffff00>{{recover}}<c> a little <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c>.
